description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes, including Certificate and Handler, which manage SSL/TLS socket connections, certificates, and validation within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It declares interfaces for secure socket operations, certificate handling, and validation callbacks.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure SSL/TLS socket port with methods for connection management, data transfer, and callback handling within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its validation context, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidator
classes.description: Interface for custom certificate validation logic, with a method to validate a given certificate.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class managing socket connection states, data transfer, and callback registration, inheriting from Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for the expected hostname.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Verify
methods.description: Verifies the certificate and returns success or error message.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Callback
methods.description: Sets the validator callback for the socket port.
